source_commit_note: Dirty tree at pack time — 30 uncommitted path(s) (IMP-0078).
changes: rev_errorlog gains rev_runurl (nvarchar 500, Format text, audited, unsecured) and it is on the Error Log main form
Failure alert writes rev_runurl from the text_5 input; the run link is no longer appended to rev_errormessage
Every caller gains an explicit Compose_run_link action whose output is passed as text_5 (intake has two, one per alert call site)
Both adaptive cards re-laid out to match the previous HTML message: title, prose line, bulleted counts, footer - replacing the FactSet layout
steps_not_executed: pack-managed and lint — targeted DEV deploy, not a release build. No solution-checker result in this artifact.

gates_executed.field-length-limits: PASS — 156 descriptions within 256 (5 initially over; condensed, reasoning moved to notes.md)

post_deploy_findings.column_not_created_by_import: THE IMPORT PUT rev_runurl ON THE FORM AND DID NOT CREATE THE COLUMN. Reported success and published. A live attribute query returned 12 rev_* columns with rev_runurl absent while the Error Log form already referenced it — a form pointing at a column that does not exist. This is what provisioning/README.md says ensure-schema.ps1 exists for: new schema is created via the Web API metadata endpoints, never by solution import.
post_deploy_findings.resolution: pwsh provisioning/dataverse/ensure-schema.ps1 -Env dev — CREATED rev_errorlog.rev_runurl, every other column EXISTS, then published. Verified live: maxlength 500, format Text, writable.
post_deploy_findings.environment_variables: ALL FIVE SURVIVED. They were promoted from definition defaults to environmentvariablevalue rows before this import, and the import did not touch them — confirming IMP-0121's fix.
post_deploy_findings.flows_deactivated: 2 of 4 (Calculate & Flag, Daily Summary). Intake and Failure Alert stayed Activated, so deactivation is not unconditional as IMP-0113 assumed.

verification_level.reached: V3 accepted, plus the column and form confirmed live by query
verification_level.not_reached: V4/V5. Two flows are off. Neither adaptive card has ever rendered and PostCardToConversation is still an unproven shape, which is why the HTML message remains wired as a fallback on both.

status: DEPLOYED TO DEV — schema completed by ensure-schema.ps1; awaiting re-activation of 2 flows
